verdict.rationale: Expensify documents an Integration Server API with generated partner credentials (partnerUserID/partnerUserSecret), secret rotation, and an OAuth2 authorization code flow that issues short-lived access tokens for acting on behalf of users. The pack does not show which data the API can pull or whether tokens can be scoped. Missing for 10: evidence that transactions, expenses, and receipts can be retrieved via the API; evidence of scoped tokens or permission granularity; confirmation the API is REST-style; independent or hands-on corroboration.
